name: DecorViz
tagline: The best AI furniture visualisation tool for your own room photo
description: DecorViz is an AI furniture visualisation tool that shows real furniture in a photo of your own room before you buy. Upload your room photo and a product photo, and Quick Generate places the piece in your space with realistic scale, lighting and shadows. With Canvas you add up to four products to your room photo, move, resize, rotate and layer each one where you want it, and DecorViz renders the whole room as one realistic image. Think of it as a mood board turned into a real photo of your space. There is a free plan, and furniture stores can offer DecorViz to shoppers through its Shopify app.
